content.text: NCAA | March 24, 2026 2026 NCAA women's basketball tournament: Bracket, schedule, scores The 64-team bracket is set and action continues Friday with the Sweet 16. We'll be covering all the action — every game from here until a champion is crowned in Arizona on April 5.
